"O Mehbooba" is a soulful and melodious song from the Bollywood classic "Sangam" (1964), featuring the legendary Raj Kapoor and Vyjayanthimala. Sung by the iconic Mukesh, the song beautifully captures themes of love and longing, showcasing the emotional depth of the film.
